scenario_description:
Objective: Make tomorrow’s deck-cleanup setup easier by using a no-cost dockside tune-up for the aft deck box lock.
Emerging Need: A mildly gritty lock becomes a worthwhile optional improvement only after a compatible resident amenity is announced with limited cart stops.
Decision Context: Stored onboard notes identify the lock model and graphite-only treatment, while live marina updates establish whether naming that model can still secure a stop.
Consequence: Ignoring the chance leaves the deck box usable as before, but once the cart list closes the convenience upgrade cannot happen before cleanup.

parameter.title: Aft deck cleanup and line locker reset
parameter.description: Sort brushes, spare line, and fender pads from the aft deck box; wipe deck box rim and return cleaning tools.

parameter.content: I put the deck brush back in the aft box. The padlock key turned, but it felt gritty again. It opened, so nothing is stuck.

parameter.subject: Complimentary dry-graphite lock tune-up today
parameter.body: Resident amenity for today: the dock operations cart will do no-charge dry-graphite tune-ups for one small marine padlock per slip between 1:00 PM and 3:20 PM. To be added to the cart route, residents should text or email dock operations with the lock make/model before 2:45 PM. Walk-up availability is not guaranteed after the route is set.

parameter.subject: Lock tune-up route nearly full
parameter.body: Update for today's dry-graphite lock tune-up: two cart stops remain. Maya is closing the route list at 2:45 PM so the cart can leave the dock office on time. Requests still need the lock make/model.

parameter.subject: Lock tune-up route closed
parameter.body: The dry-graphite lock tune-up cart list is now finalized, and the remaining graphite packets have been assigned to listed stops. There will not be a walk-up station after the cart returns.
